notes.title: Undead Horde 2: Necropolis Full Version Available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/396411/e238dc2a14e81a5db2a7fba24cd9160a57a61a35.jpg[/img]

[b]Undead Horde 2: Necropolis is now leaving early access and the full version is available![/b] This includes all planned and unplanned features, Windows and Mac version (Linux via Proton/Steamplay) and all the localizations!

Don't miss out on the special launch discount, available for a limited time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2065810/Undead_Horde_2_Necropolis/

notes.title: Skeletal Avenger Full Version Launched on Steam!
First update! Trading Cards, words, fixes, Twitch improvements.
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28679877/3a4af9663f28d5ded58c7374936a841f936bb18e.jpg[/img]

Spellspire has been received really nicely!

We've issued a handful of small updates, which amount to:

1. Steam Trading Cards. Get those sweet drops rolling!

2. Additions to dictionary based on feedback. About 90 words have been added, including "covfefe" as coined by a great American poet.

3. Bug fixes. Nothing major, the most prominent one being Endless Dungeon quest rewards.

4. Improvements to the Twitch integration. It's still a two account solution, but it's proven to be robust and people are having fun with it. Check it out, streamers!
